transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I got pretty worked up at my job the other day. I work as a personal care aide, and we were having a staff meeting. I just started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill right there in the room. 

I was dragging chairs around and waving my arms everywhere to show them how to do it. But the thing is, I couldn't seem to stop. Even when folks were telling me to just sit down and take a breath, I just kept at it. So, I'm here because of that.
At the time this was happening, did you hear or see things that other people around you did not?

Not right then at the meeting, no. But... I do hear things sometimes. Like, if I'm alone in the hallway at work, or even just at home by the laundry room, I'll hear my name. Or I'll hear one of the residents calling out for help, clear as day. 

I always go to check on them, because it sounds so real, but... there just isn't anybody there when I look.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was unusually high, excited, or irritable and your energy was much greater than usual?

Yeah, I'd say so. There are these stretches where I just feel... really bright and fired up. Like everything is finally lining up and I have all this energy to get things done. 

But the thing is, if someone tries to slow me down during those times, or if they question what I'm doing... I can get pretty irritable. I end up snapping at people a lot harder than I mean to.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest or pleasure in things most of the day, nearly every day?

No, not really. I don't think I've ever been down like that for two weeks straight. I mean, I get tired after a long shift sometimes, but I don't really get depressed or lose interest in doing things. It's usually just the opposite for me, with getting all fired up.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things when you were not feeling especially energized, elevated, or irritable?

Yeah, actually. There was a stretch not too long ago where I was feeling pretty normal... like, I was sleeping fine, not rushing around trying to do a million things at once, just calm. But even then, for a few weeks, I was still hearing my name in the hallway. And I was still absolutely sure the other aides were keeping some kind of secret notebook on me. So, yeah, it happens even when I'm not all fired up.

Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you were hearing or believing things like that, but you were not having any mood symptoms like being unusually energized, irritable, or depressed?

Yeah, like I was just saying... there was that stretch where I was feeling pretty calm. I was sleeping a normal amount, not staying up all night working on projects or rushing around. But even during that time, for a few weeks, I was still hearing my name being called out when no one was there. And I was still completely convinced the people at work were keeping notes on me. So, yes, it lasted for at least a couple of weeks even when my mood was just fine.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview confirms psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations and persistent persecutory delusions) that occurred for at least several weeks during a period of normal mood, meeting the key requirement for schizoaffective disorder. Mood symptoms are also present with episodes of elevated/irritable energy, but the transcript does not establish a full manic episode duration or a need to classify a bipolar subtype more specifically. No clear depressive episode was endorsed.
